newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Nov 6.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Nov 6.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunker steady despite higher cargo prices seen late Wednesday, traders said. A major said most sellers, anticipating cargo prices to fall, had sold their supplies at Tuesday's prices earlier in the day. But cargo prices inched higher late Wednesday. While some sellers took the opportunity to raise prices later, most shipowners had already purchased their requirments. MDO, gasoil prices were lower.
